transcript:
anya: kicking off quantization sweep for zephyr13b across regions (us-west, us-east, eu). testing fp16/bf16/int8/fp8. baseline seq=1024, batch=1..4, kernels=[fused-attn-v1, aten-optimized, custom-quant]. posting raw numbers as they finish.

sam: awesome — please include latency p50/p95, tok/s throughput, and eval delta (mrr/accuracy) vs fp16.

bench-bot: quick summary (aggregated):
```
model: zephyr13b | seq=1024 | batch=1
region: us-west (h100)
- fp16: p50=58ms p95=135ms throughput=124 tok/s | eval delta=0.0%
- bf16: p50=60ms p95=138ms throughput=120 tok/s | eval delta=+0.0% (within noise)
- int8: p50=29ms p95=78ms throughput=266 tok/s | eval delta=-0.9% MRR
- fp8: p50=36ms p95=95ms throughput=210 tok/s | eval delta=-0.25% MRR
kernel: aten-optimized best on h100 for int8, fused-attn-v1 slightly better for fp16
```

anya: raw command used:
```
./bench/run_bench --model zephyr13b --seq 1024 --batch 1 --quant int8 --gpu h100 --kernel aten-optimized --region us-west --evalset prod-sanity
```

jordan: interesting that int8 p95 variance is tighter on h100. did you warm KV cache? also which calibration set for int8? I saw a small regress on docs-heavy prompts.

anya: yes, warmup=64 steps with typical prompts. calibration used `calib/news+docs` (~5k samples). the -0.9% MRR concentrates on long-form summarization prompts (>800 tokens).

marta: capacity sizing note: for steady-state 300 QPS (avg request ~300 tokens) — projected units:
- fp16 (h100): ~8 replicas (~2.4M tok/s capacity) -> cost X
- int8 (h100): ~3 replicas (~6.6M tok/s capacity) -> ~0.4x cost vs fp16
we should add 20% headroom for p95 targets.

infra-bot: deployment check: us-west has spare h100 pool=12 GPUs, us-east a100 pool=6 GPUs, eu h100 pool=2 GPUs.

sam: kernel decision recs?

jordan: my take:
- h100: aten-optimized for int8, fallback fused-attn-v1 for fp16/ bf16.
- a100: fused-attn-v1 wins for fp16; int8 kernel still experimental (use custom-quant with per-channel scales).
- always enable KV-prefix caching for >512 seq to cut p50 by ~10%.

anya: noted. region-specific rollout plan: canary int8 in us-west (10% traffic) with aten-optimized kernel, run quality evals on live prompts for 48h. hold fp8 to eu-only internal canary (fp8 showed slight hallucination bumps on docs prompts).

marta: agree. capture token-level diffs and run automated regression alerts at delta >0.5% MRR.

sam: next steps:
- anya: run extended evals on long-form set and post calibrated confusion matrix by EOD tomorrow.
- infra: reserve 4 h100s in us-west for canary and autoscale test.
- prod-ops: prepare rollback playbook for kernel fallbacks.

anya: will do. attaching a tiny result snippet for eu (a100):
```
region: eu (a100)
- fp16: p50=72ms p95=190ms throughput=98 tok/s | eval delta=0.0%
- int8 (custom-quant): p50=45ms p95=130ms throughput=180 tok/s | eval delta=-1.4% MRR
```

marta: eu int8 regression too big for GA there. okay to run internal canary only.

bench-bot: logging artifacts: s3://bench-results/zephyr13b/1767895432/ (profiles, perf traces, eval diffs, calibration metadata)

anya: thanks — will bump thread when extended evals complete. :white_check_mark:
